blocking_obligations.detail: Frozen Algebra and Graphical semantics do not construct a RibbonGraphicalEvaluation from a TwistedPremodularCategory. The current structure is caller-supplied data.

CompositionRespectsEvaluation, naturality, fusion completeness, and tensor-unit projector laws are opaque Prop names. Their current types expose no equations from which local invariance can be proved.
RepresentativeIndependenceStatement is only a proposition. No frozen-frontend theorem proves it.
LocalMoveInvarianceStatement is only a proposition. No frozen-frontend theorem proves all eight cases.
The existing evaluateMarking acts on one HomologicallyMarkedDiagram. Without canonical evaluator data and proven choice independence it cannot define TwistedYetter((C,eta),(X,alpha)).

completed_in_this_checkpoint: Renamed the diagram-level evaluator to evaluateMarkedDiagram.
Renamed the former final theorem to ConditionalDescent.diffeomorphism_invariant_of_descent_data.
Removed the misleading public TwistedYetter and TwistedYetter_diffeomorphism_invariant names.
Retained the kernel-checked elementary-move assembly and finite-movie induction.
Replaced caller-supplied ThamDefinition511Normalization by the explicit Definition 5.11 factor globalDimension / globalDimension ^ hOne, where hOne is the turned-over index.
Split the classical topology boundary into individually named axioms and derived the internal ClassicalKirbyTopologyBoundary record instead of accepting it as a theorem parameter.
Added a complete category-neutral cut-open exterior event trace with one exact projector hole per dotted disk.
Constructed the role-aware graph compiler from the frozen cut-open trace and removed RoleAwareGraphCompiler from all evaluator and descent signatures.

Removed the duplicate requirement that the compiled final graph contain character coupons; the formal evaluator stores the character once in characterWeight, while coupons remain proof-language intermediates.
Changed the tensor-unit projector syntax from a single simple label to the entire ordered puncture word.
Required cut-open planar isotopy events to preserve the active boundary word; strand reordering must be represented by explicit crossings.
prohibited_shortcuts: No new blanket axiom for local invariance.
No new blanket axiom for representative independence.
No hidden FoundationalPackage or implicit assumptions structure.
No constant-zero or otherwise fake invariant.
No sorry, admit, arbitrary equality, backend conformance certificate, or legacy evaluator.
next_mathematical_obligation: Replace the untyped RibbonExpression and opaque graphical-law predicates by typed categorical morphisms and explicit equations; then prove representative independence and the eight local moves for the canonical compiler.
